# Optical Equator Small

A tiny three-band uint8 RGB scene in EPSG:4326 centred on the equator. Exercises low-latitude / equator-crossing extent handling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `optical_equator_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase handles an RGB optical scene whose extent spans the equator.
